name: Lacrima di Morro

known.via: English Wikipedia "Lacrima di Morro d'Alba" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A red DOC in the province of Ancona, in Marche, made from the rare local Lacrima grape. It was created in 1985.
